Frequently Asked Questions

Is there a contract or commitment?

No, all paid plans are strictly month-to-month. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription at any time directly from your dashboard.

Are there hidden transaction fees?

None. MediHub does not take a percentage of your procurement contracts. We strictly charge a flat monthly software access fee.

How does the verification process work for suppliers?

Upon registering, our compliance team reviews your business licenses, financial health, and industry certifications within 48 hours before granting the Verified Badge.
